note: v499: Deleting a loan could wipe the "Paid from" account tags another device had set since you last opened the app — it rewrote the whole list instead of just removing that loan's own. On the loan's payment calendar, tapping a day or changing month now updates only the calendar, so an opened "Show all payments" list no longer snaps shut, and two payments recorded on the same day are added together instead of one hiding the other. The loan math is now covered by tests checked against standard amortization.
